title: The effect of theta tACS on working memory
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from a study testing whether theta transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) improves working memory. Participants received either 20 minutes of verum or sham stimulation (1 mA, 6 Hz, Fpz-CPz) and then performed working memory tasks requiring mental manipulation or simple retention of items. Resting-state EEG with eyes closed and eyes open was also recorded before the task.
methods_description: Participants received 20 minutes of verum or sham tACS at 1 mA and 6 Hz applied to Fpz-CPz. EEG was then recorded during working memory tasks (manipulation vs. retention). Resting-state EEG was recorded before the task for 3 minutes with eyes closed and 1.5 minutes with eyes open.
